11784: A ronin, haunted by his terrible past, has sworn to keep his sword sheathed. However upon meeting Kotaro he finds himself re-evaluating his life. Whilst traveling with the young Kotaro, Nanashi finds himself acting as a bodyguard for the boy.
11785: Kotaro is a young orphan, seen in the opening scene being told by Father Shouan to run far away from the monastery. He finds himself being pursued by assassins sent by the Ming dynasty as well as the soldiers of Akaike.
12910: Acting as the second in command in the Ming's group, led by Byakuran - Luo-Lang stands out as he is the only Caucasian in the group. With a thirst for greater power - Luo-Lang craves equally stronger enemies so he may improve his skills.
15766: Shougen Itadori's right hand man. Very skilled with a bow though his swordsmanship is rather poor. He has feelings for the princess and dreams of marrying her one day though he realizes she is out of his reach.
24747: Feng-wu is a young Ming warrior who fights with double broadswords. A subordinate of Bai-luan, he keeps a pet falcon to deliver coded messages (coloured pieces of cloth) between his companions. His respect for Luo-lang is so great that it's closer to adoration.
27151: An ambitious retainer who seeks to gain more power. He excels at both leadership and combat with a lance.
27229: Mu-Mao is a master archeress serving as one of eight elite Ming dynasty warriors under Bai-Luan. Fighting alongside her older sister Mu-You, both seek to complete the task for which they were hired so they can return home.
35344: Shouan is a monk who serves as a mentor and guardian to Kotaro. He also provides Kotaro with the 'green teasure' which aids him in his journey to the Mangaku Temple in Shirato.
72247: Mu-You is a female Ming warrior and Mu-Mao older sister. She uses axe in combat.
121360: Tobimaru is Kotarou's dog; Whom, along with being a faithful companion, comes in handy quite a few times for both Nanashi and Kotarou.
